audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted their own whys. The chart gave Lucian Level 6, and Skill / Lucian at first and second item, while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] read "Level 6 flips to you", "Your first item lets your all-in delete him" and "Late, Yone's mobility one-shots the squishy Lucian". Level 3 was Lucian against "Level 3 evens out", and Levels 4-5 were Skill against "his combo re-spikes and out-trades".
audit.why: Packet chart reads Lucian, Lucian, Skill, Lucian, Yone, Yone, Yone — matching the whys exactly — and the mirror audit also flipped Level 6, First item and 2+ items to Yone.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill, row 3 to Lucian, rows 4, 5 and 6 to Yone on BOTH layers, with ratings moved with them, as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: The double-shot is credited to Ardent Blaze (W) in spikes[0].text and early, the dash reset is credited to Ardent Blaze in wants.foe[1], and Fate Sealed is described as a knockup in spikes[1].text and mid.
audit.why: Lightslinger is the passive: "Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot." Ardent Blaze is the marking missile that grants him move speed. The cooldown reduction on Relentless Pursuit comes from Lightslinger attacks, not from W. And Yone's R pulls — it blinks behind the last champion and drags everyone hit toward him, no knockup involved.
audit.corrected: Rebuilt all five fields on the real owners: Lightslinger for the double-shot and the E cooldown reduction, Fate Sealed as a blink-and-pull.

audit.whatIsWrong: Relentless Pursuit was described only as "his dash + reset" with no number, and The Culling had none either.
audit.why: Relentless Pursuit is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s but Lightslinger attacks reduce it — so the player should be counting his attacks, not a fixed timer, which is a genuinely different instruction. The Culling is 110/100/90s and 1400 range.
audit.corrected: Wrote both numbers, and the attack-based reduction, into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, phases[3].why and early.

edits.before: Lucian is a lane bully early — his Piercing Light (Q) and the double-shot from Ardent Blaze (W) chunk you every time you step up to CS, and his E dash lets him slip your Mortal Steel (Q3). Levels 1-2 belong to him, so farm patiently and don't commit to trades where he can dash out and re-poke. Track his E cooldown; that dash is his whole safety net.

notes: Ardent Blaze was being credited with two things it does not do — the double-shot (that is Lightslinger) and the dash reset (Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit). Fate Sealed corrected from a knockup to a blink-and-pull in two fields. The _missing file lists 'needs-antiheal' for Lucian via Lightslinger; Riot's passive text describes bonus damage when he is healed or shielded BY AN ALLY, not any self-healing, so I did not write an anti-heal recommendation — that rule looks like a flag misfire in a solo-lane context. Left alone: diffRating 8.5/10 and carryRating 8.5/10 now sit oddly against a chart where Yone owns the last three rows and a 51.84% win rate.
